title: One module records California operations and another does not.
detail: The classification module lists California among the states worked in; the employment practices module does not. Both questions ask where the same people work. California attaches obligations on both sides of that answer: securing workers compensation for every employee [S:ca-labor-code-3700], and harassment prevention training at five employees [S:ca-gov-12950-1]. Whichever answer is stale, one of these two modules is now reasoning from the wrong map.
action: Open both modules and make the state lists agree, then re-read whichever findings changed.
author: Aaron Bollinger
